sentences.en: You don't have proper dignity as chief of the section.
sentences.zh: 你作为部门主管不够有尊严。

sentences.en: There are seven men and four women in my section.
sentences.zh: 我的部门里有七个男性和四个女性。

sentences.en: Dad said he'd be promoted to section manager next year.
sentences.zh: 爸爸说他明年会被晋升为部门经理。

senses.zh: 被切割成片；被分成部分 -
把…分段；将…切片；对…进行划分
